notes.title: 2026年10月20日の更新
en: [Inference hooks](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/inference-hooks) are out of beta for Claude Enterprise organizations.

We've launched [user profiles](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/user-profiles), so you can tell Anthropic which of your end customers each API request is for. If you operate a platform or gateway, or resell API access, a safety enforcement action can then apply to one end customer instead of your whole organization. The SDK and the `ant` CLI support the new [`/v1/user_profiles` endpoints](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/user_profiles).

We've added [organization webhooks](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/organization-webhooks) to the [Admin API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/admin-api), in beta with the `webhooks-2026-10-07` beta header. Its [`/v1/organizations/webhooks` endpoints](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/webhooks) register webhook endpoints for two event types: one for when Anthropic restricts or bans one of your organization's user profiles, and one for when the restriction or ban ends. To request access, contact your Anthropic account team.

notes.title: 2026年10月15日の更新
en: We've added `capabilities.thinking.types.between_tools` to the [Models API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/models/list). `GET /v1/models` and `GET /v1/models/{model_id}` now report whether each model accepts `thinking: {type: "between_tools"}`, which turns off up-front thinking. See [Using the Models API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview#using-the-models-api).

The [Compliance API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-api) now returns the text each organization member saved as **Instructions for Claude** in claude.ai and as **Global instructions** in Cowork, in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations. Call `GET /v1/compliance/organizations/{org_uuid}/user_preferences` with your existing Compliance Access Key and the `read:compliance_user_data` scope. See [List user preferences](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-org-data#list-user-preferences).

[Fast mode](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode) is out of research preview for Claude Opus 5.5, and you no longer need to request access. Requests to Claude Opus 5.5 no longer require the `fast-mode-2026-02-01` beta header, and requests that still send it keep working. Claude Opus 5.5 now has a default fast mode rate limit in the Start, Build, and Scale usage tiers. Fast mode for Claude Opus 5 and Claude Opus 4.8 remains in research preview. Keep sending the beta header with fast mode requests to those models.

[Fast mode](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode) for Claude Opus 5.5 is now available on [Claude in Microsoft Foundry](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-microsoft-foundry) for deployments hosted on Azure.

notes.title: 2026年10月14日の更新
en: We've launched [OpenTelemetry export](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/opentelemetry) in beta, so you can trace Messages API requests and Claude Managed Agents sessions in your observability backend. The Claude SDK emits spans in Python, TypeScript, C#, Go, Java, PHP, and Ruby. To get spans from the API, [add an OpenTelemetry destination](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/opentelemetry/api#add-a-destination) in the Claude Console.

Claude Managed Agents [scheduled deployments](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/scheduled-deployments) are now available on [Claude Platform on AWS](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-platform-on-aws#claude-managed-agents).

code.title: Claude Code 2.1.306（日本語）
en: Fixed `claude -p` inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables
Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools

code.title: Claude Code 2.1.305（日本語）
en: Added `sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces` so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset

Fixed every request failing on Vertex, Bedrock and other providers when the endpoint or a gateway rejects tool search, and behind gateways with ToolSearch disallowed or left out of `--tools` (a 2.1.304 regression): Claude Code now retries without it
Fixed `/effort` and `/autocompact` settings not applying when the model name differed from a `modelOverrides` value by letter case or a `[1m]` tag
Fixed new worktrees in a bare repository sometimes starting from local HEAD instead of the default branch, and unchanged subagent worktrees sometimes not being cleaned up
Fixed Bash commands on a full disk failing with a raw `ENOSPC` file path: the error now says the disk is full and that nothing ran
Fixed an MCP server passed by a cloud session or by the SDK's `setMcpServers` being replaced later in the session by a same-named server from your own settings
Fixed Claude naming the wrong model for a subagent's work after the subagent switched to a fallback model

code.title: Claude Code 2.1.304（日本語）
en: Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin
Added `decider: "person"` to a mod's `tool.check` answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked
Added `e.isReadOnly` to a mod's `tool.check` event, set when the tool call is read-only

Added `/auto-mode-setup`: a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your environment, now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude apps gateway and telemetry-disabled sessions
Added `/claude-api managed-agents-secure`, which compares a Managed Agents agent's settings with Anthropic's published security guide, without changing anything
Added the names of the tools called earlier to the compaction summary in the transcript view (Ctrl+O)

Added a warning on Pro and Max plans when resuming an inactive conversation would use a noticeable share of your 5-hour usage limit: resume anyway, or start a new conversation and Claude can look up the previous one if you refer to it
Fixed the organization policy not refreshing until the hourly check after approving an `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` at startup or switching "Use custom API key" in `/config`
